capabilities: convert soft line breaks to hard line breaks in the current document
limit conversion to paragraphs and blockquotes
choose between two-space and backslash hard-break format
extras: An earlier auto-convert-while-typing feature was removed because the Obsidian API lacks safe events for it; batch conversion of multiple documents is listed as a possible future feature.
motivation: The author wants portable Markdown without manually typing two trailing spaces or a backslash, arguing soft line breaks serve no purpose in Obsidian since the editor wraps text.
problem: Obsidian's 'Strict line breaks' setting hides the difference between soft and hard line breaks, producing documents that don't render line breaks correctly on other Markdown platforms.
summary: Line-break converter that adds an editor command replacing soft line breaks with Markdown hard line breaks in paragraphs and blockquotes.
